snippet.title: Model Kit Studio - Official Playtest Launch Trailer | Women-Led Games x SGF 2026
snippet.description: Check out the Playtest Launch Trailer for Model Kit Studio, a serene model-building simulation game developed by Spooky Rabbits. Players will dive into the flow state with a relaxing soundtrack to build models, meet friends, and grow the collection for all to see. Model Kit Studio is coming soon to PC (Steam), with a playtest available now for Steam.
